description: This file defines data structures and utility functions for serializing and parsing HTTP alternative service headers, supporting HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and QUIC ALTSVC frames, including the class SpdyAltSvcWireFormat and its nested AlternativeService structure.

classes.name: SpdyAltSvcWireFormat
classes.description: Class providing static methods for parsing and serializing Alt-Svc header values, and managing alternative service data structures.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Data structure representing an alternative service, including protocol ID, host, port, max age, and version vector.

methods.name: ParseHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Parses a string value into a vector of AlternativeService objects.

methods.name: SerializeHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Serializes a vector of AlternativeService objects into a string suitable for header fields.

methods.name: SkipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a string view iterator.

methods.name: PercentDecode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded sequences within a string view.

methods.name: ParseAltAuthority
methods.description: Parses authority component (host and port) from a string view.

methods.name: ParsePositiveInteger16
methods.description: Parses a positive 16-bit integer from a string view.

methods.name: ParsePositiveInteger32
methods.description: Parses a positive 32-bit integer from a string view.

methods.name: HexDigitToInt
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its integer value.

methods.name: HexDecodeToUInt32
methods.description: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a 32-bit unsigned integer.
